def determine_winner(n1, n2, k1, k2):
    # If the first player can force a win by making the second player face a losing position
    if (n1 - 1) % (k1 + 1) == 0 and (n2 - 1) % (k2 + 1) == 0:
        return "Second"
    else:
        return "First"

# Read input
n1, n2, k1, k2 = map(int, input().split())

# Determine and print the winner
print(determine_winner(n1, n2, k1, k2))
